text.3d0c4002.text: The river collects those pieces of my life into the same place. You can follow it in order, or stop wherever something catches your attention.

text.e0435217.text: I enjoy technology, photography, writing and working with music.

image.band.0.text: Stage lights above a music producer and guitarists.

text.8f0a9e08.text: My place in the band is usually offstage: playing rhythm guitar, making drum demos, and working behind the camera.

text.1f299f39.text: At some performances, I am not even on stage. I am crouched below it, photographing the people who are.

text.8b619d56.text: The rhythm guitar coming through the speakers is the part I recorded; the photographs that become the band's visual memory are the frames I made.
